item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i sgrub pa las tshe dbang thugs kyi bcud dril
item.coloph: bdag 'dra mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis kong yul bon gyi gnas chen gyi dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas/ sa rta zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin par sgra snyan rol mo dang bcas te dpon slob 'ga' yis mthong sar spyan drangs nas/ slar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi tha grur mkhas pa spa yi gdung las skyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa a yu khi khar gyis bskul te g.yung drung rnam rgyal gling gi rtse ru shog ser bod yig tu dag par bsgyur ba'i dge des mnyam med rgyal ba'i bstan pa de nyid 'go 'dzin mi yi khyon kun khyab pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
